newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castorseed prices steady, subdued sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Indian castorseed prices steady, subdued sentiment.

text.p: Indian castorseed June delivery on Thursday held steady in a narrow price band at 1,187/1,189 rupees per quintal amid limited activity, dealers said.
"Major players kept to the sidelines awaiting the presentation of the union budget on Friday and trading volumes were at low ebb," one dealer said.
Sentiment was subdued amidst poor overseas demand. Dealers said the market may bounce back due to lower arrivals in producing centres.
Groundnut oil was steady at 342/343 rupees per 10 kg amid lower arrivals of 40/50 tonnes while physical demand was down.
Imported palm oil was quiet at 281/282 rupees per 10 kg.
Market sentiment for edible oil however remained firm on expectations that the government may hike import duty on edible oils in the budget.
